entries.core_move: Delay a continuous-time signal by shifting each key time point, breakpoint, and support interval T units to the right while preserving the signal's shape and values.
Advance a continuous-time signal by shifting each key time point, breakpoint, and support interval T units to the left while preserving the signal's shape and values.
Interpret $x(t-T)$ for $T > 0 by mapping each original feature time t0 to t0 + T and recognizing the result as a T-unit delay$.
Interpret $x(t+T)$ for $T > 0 by mapping each original feature time t0 to t0 - T and recognizing the result as a T-unit advance$.
Convert a piecewise continuous-time signal into its shifted form by moving each breakpoint in the shift direction and assigning each original formula to the corresponding new interval.
Convert delayed and advanced exponential signals by substituting t - T or t + T into $e^{st}$ and factoring the shift into the constant multiplier $e^{-sT}$ or $e^{sT}$.
